title: Demand Pre-Sales Excellence -Oracle Finance - Senior Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Demand Pre\-Sales Excellence \- Oracle Finance \- Senior Manager, you will lead and innovate within our Oracle Finance practice, focusing on delivering strategic solutions to our clients. As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and experience to guide large projects, drive operational excellence, and interact with clients at a strategic level to validate project success. You will be instrumental in developing high\-performing teams, solving complex problems, and applying sound judgment to make impactful decisions.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of our Digital Core Modernisation network, working within our Finance Technology \- Oracle Core ERP practice. You will have the opportunity to influence and shape the future of finance technology solutions, collaborating with diverse teams to deliver quality results. Your role will involve crafting clear and engaging messages, validating outcomes with clients, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. This position offers a dynamic environment where you can deepen your skills and contribute to the success of our firm.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Leading the development and execution of Oracle Finance solutions to enhance client financial processes
* Managing client relationships and providing strategic financial advice to drive successful project outcomes
* Overseeing the implementation of Oracle Financials, including modules such as Oracle General Ledger and Oracle Receivables
* Coordinating with cross\-functional teams to deliver comprehensive finance transformation initiatives
* Utilizing financial modeling and forecasting skills to support client decision\-making and business planning
* Monitoring and analyzing financial trends to identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies
* Confirming compliance with financial regulations and standards through diligent financial reporting and analysis
* Coaching and mentoring team members to foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth
* Collaborating with stakeholders to design and implement innovative financial management solutions
* Presenting financial reports and insights to clients, facilitating informed decision\-making and strategic planning


 What You Must Have
   

  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 15 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting \& Finance, Finance, Economics, Business Administration/Management, Management Information Systems
* At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Financials or related Oracle ERP Finance Cloud modules
* Leading finance transformation initiatives using Oracle Financials
* Managing complex financial reporting and analysis projects
* Utilizing Oracle Hyperion Financial Management for strategic financial planning
* Demonstrating advanced skills in financial risk management and compliance
* Innovating finance process improvements in Oracle ERP environments

title: Alternative Fund Services - Private Fund Services - Fund Accounting - Team Leader - Bangalore
description:
**Job Description**
 Job title
   

  

 Team Leader – Alternative Fund Services \- Private Fund Services \- Fund Administration
   

  

 Short description
   

  

 Join a team of passionate and dedicated professionals in Alternative Fund Administration industry working for one of the world's most innovative banks.
   

  

 Posting description
   

  

 The ideal candidate for this role should have a strong background in accounting, excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, and an eye for detail.
   

  

 As a Team Leader in our Private Equity and Real Estate Services Fund Administration team, you will be responsible for administering private equity funds and other alternative investment vehicles, including preparing \& reviewing financial statements and reports and providing support for investor relations activities. You will be responsible for bookkeeping, reconciliation, calculating fees, preparing financial statements and investor reports, and process improvements.
   

  

 You should be comfortable working with computers and have an aptitude for learning new software and systems quickly.
   

  

 If you think you have what it takes to join our team, apply now!
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Perform daily, monthly, quarterly and annual accounting functions, Book and review journal entries into Accounting application, Reconcile accounts
* Prepare and review fund level financial statements including the consolidated balance sheet, income statement, statement of partners' capital, schedule of investments, footnotes to financial statements and cash flows
* Prepare and review investor capital calls, distributions notices
* Understand fund agreements in order to determine impact on reporting
* Review the work of team members and provide feedback for improvement in order to ensure timely delivery of quality output
* Proactively anticipate, communicate and escalate issues to Manager in a timely manner
* Work on special and ad hoc projects for internal initiatives \& external clients


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Bachelor's / Master's degree in Accounting / ICWA / CA / MBA / CPA
* Minimum of 2 years of accounting experience, in private equity or hedge fund accounting
* High level of proficiency in Excel
* Attention to detail, Innovative and analytical thinking with excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Team player instincts with the ability to see a project to conclusion with little follow\-up
* Superb sense of client service with ability to appropriately exercise professional skepticism and judgment


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills**
* Familiarity with various private equity legal and investment structures
* Familiarity with various waterfall models
* Experience using partnership accounting applications (e.g., Investran)


**ABOUT US**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Bring more to life.**
 Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
   

  

 At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
   

  

 You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
   

  

 At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, we know time is the most critical facet in the laboratory today:  time to get life\-saving therapies to patients faster; reclaiming time by automating tedious manual workflows; and saving time spent addressing erroneous or complex results.
   

  

 We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300\+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.
   

  

 It’s all part of our time\-tested approach to bringing meaningful innovations at the speed of life since 1935\. And we’re just beginning. Working together, let’s put our time and talents together to advance human health for tomorrow.
   

  

 Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
   

  

**Job SUMMARY:** 
 The Sr. Financial Analyst is responsible for providing financial insights and projections to facilitate decision\-making to the Commercial Leaders. This role involves analyzing financial data, preparing reports, and developing financial models to support strategic planning and operational efficiency.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 
 include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
   

  

* Lead the preparation of the annual budget and monthly forecasts by working with the commercial leaders in the region
* Analyze variances between actuals, budget, and forecast, and explain key drivers for Top Line and Bottom Line.
* Prepare detailed monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and models for revenue, costs, headcount for senior management and highlighting key metrics and trends.
* Develop Monthly KPI’s Management Reports and Dashboard
* Partner with functional leaders (Sales, Operations, Accounting and Sales Ops) to gather financial data and understand business drivers.
* Drive Cost Control Measures in the region and Sustain the Operating Margins as per the Budget and Forecast
* Review Pricing for each product and monitor and provide insight into pricing to the General Manager and drive price increase initiative.
* Ensure Revenue Recognition Process is followed as per the Rev Rec Policy and Partner with accounting team on revenue recognition review process as required.
* Review of Sales Incentive and ensure correct accruals and payouts in line with the compliance as per the Beckman Financial Policy
* Collaborate with Accounting team and drive Satisfactory rating on BEC LS Internal Audits in in the region.
* Review of Demo Assets ageing and ensure the Demo Policy is followed for each transaction.
* Support ad\-hoc financial analysis and projects as required by senior management.
* Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal policies.
* Good Team Member and work collaboratively with the cross functional team.


**EDUCATION And EXPERIENCE**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA from Top B Schools/CA /CMA preferred.
* Minimum of 5\-7 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, preferably in a corporate environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
* Proficient in financial modeling and advanced Excel skills.
* Experience with financial planning software and ERP systems (e.g. Oracle, OBI and EPM) is preferred.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey financial concepts to non\-financial stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.


**Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* High level of integrity and ethical standards.
* Strong leadership and team management abilities.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.


 Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.
   

  

 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: VP, Finance
description:
Botsync is Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. We're a Singapore\-based robotics and automation company building autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and intelligent orchestration software that transform warehouse and factory operations across APAC. We design, manufacture, and deploy intelligent robots, including our MAG series, that handle material movement at scale so humans can focus on higher\-value work.
   

  

 As Botsync scales deployments, expands internationally, and prepares for Series\-B fundraising, this role builds and owns the company's financial, accounting, legal, and investor\-facing backbone. Twelve months in, success looks like clean, audit\-ready financials across all entities with strong cash runway visibility and improved working capital cycles, smooth execution of Series\-B fundraising and investor diligence, a robust legal and compliance framework with minimal founder dependency, and a finance function built to scale with Botsync's global ambitions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Financial strategy and leadership
+ Own Botsync's financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning
+ Build and maintain multi\-entity, multi\-country financial models across hardware, software, and services
+ Provide the CEO and Board with clear financial insights, unit economics, and cash runway visibility
+ Drive capital efficiency, margin improvement, and working capital optimization

* Accounting, controls and compliance
+ Own end\-to\-end accounting operations across all entities (Singapore, India, Australia, and others), ensuring monthly, quarterly, and annual closes are accurate and on time
+ Manage statutory audits, tax filings, GST/VAT, transfer pricing, and regulatory compliance
+ Establish and maintain strong internal controls, approval matrices, and financial SOPs and reporting automation

* Legal, governance and fundraising
+ Act as the internal owner of all legal and corporate matters, coordinating with external counsel on shareholder agreements, ESOPs, customer contracts, and vendor agreements
+ Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, cross\-border regulations, and board governance; support board meetings, resolutions, cap tables, and statutory filings
+ Lead financial preparation for Series\-B and future fundraising rounds, owning investor data rooms, financial models, projections, and due diligence coordination
+ Work with the CEO on investor conversations, term sheet analysis and negotiation, cap table and dilution planning, and act as a key point of contact for existing investors, VCs, and strategic partners

* Banking, treasury and team building
+ Manage relationships with banks, lenders, and financial institutions; structure and negotiate working capital lines, bank guarantees, trade finance, LC facilities, and FX hedging
+ Own cash management, treasury operations, and risk mitigation, including monitoring currency exposure across multi\-country operations
+ Build and lead a high\-performing finance and accounting team, mentoring finance managers across regions
+ Implement scalable processes suitable for enterprise customers and global audits, and act as a trusted finance partner to Sales, Operations, and Product teams


**Requirements**
**Essential**
* 10\-15\+ years in finance leadership roles, ideally within VC\-backed startups or hardware \+ SaaS / deep\-tech / industrial companies
* Proven ownership of company\-wide finance and accounting across multi\-entity, multi\-country operations
* Direct experience leading fundraising and investor interactions, including Series\-A / Series\-B rounds
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition for hardware, software, and services, working\-capital\-heavy business models, and cross\-border taxation and compliance
* CA / CPA / CFA or equivalent qualification


**Highly desirable**
* Experience setting up ESOPs, share buy\-backs, and vesting frameworks, and exposure to manufacturing, robotics, or industrial automation


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Finance Analyst
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Finance \& Accounting Group, Finance \& Accounting Group \> Finance
   

  

**General Summary**
**Hiring Title: Finance Analyst**
**About GBFS Team:** 
 The Global Business and Finance Support (GBFS) team provide support to HQ and global regional team on Finance \& Business Operation activities. This job role required to support and manage finance related activities – FP\&A, Opex and reporting \& System updates etc.
   

  

**Job Overview:** 
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented and focused\-minded financial analyst to join our finance team. The financial analyst's responsibilities include ensuring accurate and timely deliverables of financial packages and reports, financial system updates, assisting with financial planning and budgeting processes and performing research and analysis as may be required by stakeholders. You will be required to take late\-evening calls for reviews and transition of activities based on the supporting region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ensure accurate and timely deliverables of (transactional and analytics) financial packages and reporting.
* Assisting with budgeting and monthly close processes.
* Understanding key business drivers.
* Assisting global teams with financial guidance.
* Performing research and analysis as required.
* Updating Financial system with the latest data.
* Work closely with global region teams with regular interaction to reviews, drive transition calls, process documentation for all activities.
* Engage in driving automation of finance process via AI and other possible automations to bring efficiency
* Ensuring compliance with financial guidelines, company policies, and relevant legal regulations.


**Requirements**
* Master’s in finance from reputed B\-school (MBA / M. Com) or Qualified CA/CMA
* 4\+ years of experience in Finance FP\&A.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and SAP, Oracle, or related financial systems.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented and able to perform in a high\-pressure environment.
* Ability to present financial information to a non\-financial audience.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to review process and support team.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn and upskills with tools – Tableau, Power BI , AI etc.
* Flexible for Late Evening calls for reviews and transition calls on regular basis with global teams.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree.
* 1\+ year of Finance, Accounting, or related work experience.
* Completed advanced degree in a relevant field may be substituted for up to one year (Master’s \= one year) of work experience.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Senior Financial Analyst** 




**A global bank standing up its India technology and operations centre** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India — on\-site
 



**About the Company** 




 A leading global bank is establishing its India centre and has partnered with Flexiple to build its finance function. You will be a senior voice on a team that owns the numbers a marquee institution runs on. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 



**Role Overview** 




 As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will lead planning and analysis cycles end to end, owning the forecasts, board reporting, and deep\-dive analysis that shape capital and cost decisions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Planning \& Forecasting** 



* Own annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long\-range planning
* Lead variance analysis and explain drivers to senior stakeholders

**Reporting \& Review** 



* Prepare board\-level and leadership reporting packs
* Partner with business heads on cost, headcount, and spend

**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* 5 to 10 years in FP\&A, financial analysis, or corporate finance
* Advanced Excel modelling and confident stakeholder communication
* A structured, detail\-driven thinker comfortable with ambiguity
* Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote\-work setup



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in banking, financial services, or a global GCC
* CA, CFA, or MBA in Finance
* Hands\-on with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or a planning tool



**What We Offer** 



* A senior finance seat at a global bank's India centre

* Visibility with leadership and real decision impact
* One application considered for this and future matched roles



**Hiring Process** 




 HR Screening → Assignment → Leadership Round 1 → Leadership Round 2 → Culture Fit

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Innovate in Bengaluru**
 This position is based at our on\-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting\-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on\-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.
   

  

**About Lowe’s**
 Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86\.3 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com
   

  

 Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Finance Decision Support \& Analytics (FDS\&A)
 **Shared Services** 
 team partners with HR, Finance and Legal to provide financial planning, forecasting, reporting and decision support for complex enterprise expense areas. The team combines financial analysis, business acumen and analytics to improve forecast accuracy, identify risks and opportunities, and enable informed business decisions.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Lead Analyst will own end\-to\-end planning, forecasting and analysis for complex enterprise and non\-departmental expense lines supporting HR, Finance and Legal, with a significant focus on healthcare and related employee benefit costs. The role will develop and strengthen driver\-based forecasts, evaluate scenarios and sensitivities, identify risks and opportunities, and translate financial and operational inputs into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders. This role requires strong FP\&A judgment, the ability to understand and challenge key business, vendor and actuarial assumptions, and the independence to drive complex workstreams across Lowe's India and U.S. teams. The Lead Analyst will also mentor team members and lead process, automation and forecasting improvements that strengthen accuracy, efficiency and decision support.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own end\-to\-end planning, forecasting and analysis for complex expense lines across HR, Finance and Legal, including healthcare, risk \& casualty and other non\-departmental expenses.
* Develop and continuously improve driver\-based forecasting approaches, incorporating key cost drivers, historical trends, business changes and relevant vendor or actuarial assumptions.
* Lead variance, scenario and sensitivity analysis; quantify risks and opportunities, explain underlying drivers and recommend forecast or business actions.
* Build, enhance and maintain robust financial models and forecasting tools with clear assumptions, validation checks and documentation.
* Partner with business and Finance stakeholders across Lowe's India and U.S. teams to challenge assumptions, reconcile inputs and align on forecast changes and key business updates.
* Prepare executive\-ready reporting, commentary and insights that clearly communicate performance, drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Lead process improvement, standardization and automation initiatives to improve forecast accuracy, efficiency, scalability and controls.
* Mentor and review the work of team members, providing guidance on forecasting logic, model structure, assumptions and analytical quality.
* Independently manage multiple workstreams and deliver high\-quality outputs with strong attention to detail, ownership and follow\-through.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Finance, FP\&A or financial decision support, with demonstrated ownership of complex planning and forecasting processes.
* Significant experience in planning, forecasting and analyzing expense lines; experience with healthcare, employee benefits or other complex driver\-based expenses is preferred.
* Experience partnering with cross\-functional business and Finance stakeholders; experience in a GCC, shared services or global operating model is preferred.


**Education Qualification \& Certifications (preferable)**
* Qualified finance professional i.e. CA, CMA, CIMA, CFA or equivalent
* MBA with Finance specialization


**Skill Set Required**
* Strong Finance and FP\&A acumen, including driver\-based forecasting, variance analysis, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and risk \& opportunity assessment.
* Ability to understand complex expense drivers and translate business, operational, vendor and actuarial inputs into reliable forecasts and insights.
* Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with strong attention to model structure, data validation and accuracy.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and reach sound conclusions.
* Strong stakeholder management and business partnering capabilities, including the ability to challenge assumptions and influence without authority.
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive\-level commentary, insights and recommendations.
* Proven ability to prioritize multiple workstreams, work independently and maintain high standards of quality and follow\-through.
* Ability to mentor and review others' work, strengthening analytical rigor and team capability.


**Secondary Skills (desired)**
* SQL – basic/ intermediate knowledge
* Experience in Financial Planning tools e.g. IBM Planning Analytics (TM1\)

title: Associate Manager, Business Operations FP&A
description:
**About Astellas**
 Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en) .
   

  

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**
 We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
   

  

**Purpose And Scope**
 This position executes FP\&A operations for its FBP and business customers. This role heavily collaborates with business operations members, the COE, Systems and Reporting teams to deliver high quality, on time services.
   

  

 It provides high quality reporting results effectively for all FBPs with insights and recommended actions from FBPs. Meanwhile, it provides systematic variance analysis \& additional fundamental analysis support to FBPs \& Business, which are relevant to the sustainability of the operation.
   

  

 It operates the execution of the financial planning process, supporting the business to input their planning information, coordinating with the FBPs to review plans with business leaders and make necessary adjustments to the plan based on feedback.
   

  

 It supports accounting operations collaborating with GBS e.g., accruals entries etc to ensure monthly/quarterly/yearly closing is complying with financial and fiscal requirements, in line with relevant control frameworks.
   

  

**Responsibilities And Accountabilities**
**Month\-end Close:**
* Collaborate with GBS to ensure accurate reporting of management accounts, timely and in compliance with corporate policies and statutory requirements.
* In collaboration with the COE systems team validate data in financial systems for accuracy and compliance.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs to analyse variances between actual results and budget/forecasts, providing insights and recommendations, which includes detailed review and analysis of OPEX and headcounts.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs through conducting monthly and ad\-hoc financial analyses – provide key highlights on costs, headcounts tracking and cost efficiency analysis.
* Prepare financial reports and dashboards for management.


**Forecasting \& Budgeting**
* Responsible for the development of various forecasting \& budgeting templates / consolidation templates and management reporting.
* Support the implementation and roll out of financial reporting tool and system, as \& when applicable.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs in the development of annual budget, quarter forecasting as well as mid\-term plan.
* Support markets / areas / regional FBPs in analysing financial trends and performance metrics to allow FBPs to provide actionable insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Assist business and FBPs in the creation of various financial scenarios model to support the development of business case to support strategic decision\-making and risk management.
* Work closely with COE system team to ensure data accuracy and integrity in the financial systems.


**Compliance**
* Embed Compliance Culture, ensuring Integrity in Action is actively applied in all initiatives, and proactively address non\-compliance.
* Ensure a culture of Ethics and Compliance; lead by example and incorporate cross\-cultural perspectives when addressing challenging situations.


**Others**
* Support Coordination with relevant stakeholders to validate financial calendar and required system adjustments before official release.


**Required Qualifications**
* BS/BA in Finance / Accounting / Economics or related discipline
* MBA and / or CPA / CIMA and / or equivalent certificates (or qualified by experience)
* English conversational and business English Preferred Qualifications:
* Profound work experience in planning and budgeting in Pharma industry
* Solid working knowledge of accounting and internal control standards
* Experience with ERP systems
* Experience with planning tools
* Strong Microsoft word, PowerPoint skills and Advanced Excel
* Solid experience in matrix environment
* Solid organization, project, and change management skills
* Demonstrated initiative and creativity in pioneering new approaches and ways of working.
* Experience and demonstrated aptitude leveraging enterprise\-grade finance data / reporting systems.
* Solid communication skills and ability to influence with various management levels.
* Profound financial analysis skills, coupled with ability to communicate meaning from data.

title: Senior Analyst, Credit Underwriting & Analysis - Bangalore
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Under general supervision (while working independently most of the time), the Senior Analyst – Credit Risk in Wealth Management is responsible for conducting in\-depth credit analysis of high\-net\-worth individuals (HNWIs), privately held businesses, not\-for\-profit organizations, and commercial real estate clients. The Senior Analyst will analyze financial data using tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, assess creditworthiness, and develop credit analysis reports to support underwriting and lending decisions.
   

  

 In this role, the Senior Analyst manages complex credit analysis assignments, mentors junior analysts, and ensures the accuracy and quality of credit spreads. The Senior Analyst also works on strategic and special projects identified by management.
   

  

 Collaboration with relationship managers and internal stakeholders is required to structure credit facilities that align with clients’ wealth management goals while adhering to Northern Trust’s risk management. This position offers exposure to sophisticated financial products, a dynamic work environment, and opportunities to develop expertise in credit analysis for the wealth management sector.
   

  

**Major Duties**
* Analyzes financial statements, credit reports, and economic data to assess the creditworthiness of individuals or businesses.
* Prepares comprehensive credit reports with a high degree of independence, focusing on operational performance, financial health, and identification of key risk mitigants.
* Monitors borrower performance and ensures timely identification of potential risks by conducting thorough annual reviews.
* Mentors junior analysts to ensure adherence to established standards and guidelines.
* Contributes to division\-wide initiatives and special projects as assigned by management.
* Collaborates with onshore partners and relationship managers to develop tailored credit solutions.
* Ensures adherence to Northern Trust’s credit policies, compliance standards, process\-related guidelines, and controls.
* Consistently adheres to established QUALITY \& QUANTITY SLAs.
* Stays informed about market trends, regulatory changes, and economic factors affecting credit risk.
* Pays attention to detail to ensure all documents are processed correctly.
* Identifies process changes to improve productivity and efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Graduation or above degree in finance, accounting, or business administration (or equivalent)
* Additional certifications such as CFA, FRM, CMA, etc., are considered advantageous but are not mandatory.


**Experience \& Skills**
* 2 \- 4 years of experience in financial spreading and credit memo underwriting, strong financial analysis and analytical skills. Familiarity with lending products such as lines of credit and term loans is required.
* Excellent time management skills, with the ability to multitask, work independently, and handle competing priorities under pressure.
* Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner, effectively telling the story behind financials in a compelling way.
* Ability to research issues/problems and provide a ‘solution\-based’ approach
* Excellent verbal and written communication and partnering skills. A confident and personable attitude with the ability to communicate effectively with onshore relationship managers and other stakeholders
* Self\-motivated individual to go beyond immediate responsibilities
* Familiarity with Moody’s Credit Lens or similar credit spreading tools. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word and other Microsoft 365 tools.
* Capability to coach and mentor junior team members.


**Shift Coverage:** 
 EMEA \- 12:30PM to 9:30PM IST
   

  

**About The Team**
 This position is within the Financial Risk Division, organizationally aligned under Global Risk. The department plays a pivotal role in the credit underwriting process, monitoring loans, assessing risks across credit portfolios thereby safeguarding the organization’s financial stability by ensuring rigorous credit analysis, adherence to regulatory standards, and the implementation of robust risk mitigation strategies. Through its oversight and expertise, the Financial Risk Division contributes significantly to the institution’s overall risk management framework, supporting prudent lending decisions and promoting long\-term organizational resilience.
   

  

 The Credit Services division serves the Northern Trust Wealth Management customers including Global Family Office clients through a range of lending services, including but not limited to Secured, Unsecured loans to Individuals, and their privately held entities, and Commercial Real estate lending.
   

  

**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**
 The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Financial Controller

**Role Description** 




 We are looking for an experienced Finance Controller to take ownership of the company's
 



 financial planning, reporting, controls, cash flow, and accounting operations.
 



 The role will work closely with the Founder/Management, Operations, Sales, Procurement,
 



 and Project Teams to ensure strong financial controls, healthy cash flows, accurate project
 



 profitability, timely collections, and disciplined vendor payments.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in a project\-based or
 



 construction/interiors/real\-estate environment, where financial management involves
 



 multiple ongoing projects, customer collections, vendor payments, material procurement,
 



 project\-level costing, and working\-capital management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Financial Planning \& MIS
 



 • Own weekly, monthly, and annual financial reporting and MIS.
 



 • Prepare and present financial dashboards covering revenue, collections, expenses,
 



 margins, cash flow, and profitability.
 



 • Develop project\-wise and company\-level P\&L reporting.
 



 • Track actual performance against budgets and forecasts and highlight key variances.
 



 • Provide management with actionable financial insights for business decisions.
 



 • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.
 



 2\. Project Finance \& Profitability
 



 • Establish and monitor project\-wise financial performance and profitability.
 



 • Track project revenue, material costs, labour costs, subcontractor costs, overheads,
 



 and other project expenses.
 



 • Monitor project budgets against actual expenditure and identify cost overruns early.
 



 • Work with Project Managers and Operations to improve project margins and cost
 



 controls.
 



 • Ensure revenue recognition, project billing, and cost allocation are accurate and
 



 timely.
 



 • Develop mechanisms to track contribution margins across projects and locations.
 



 3\. Cash Flow \& Working Capital
 



 • Take ownership of the company's cash\-flow planning and working\-capital
 



 management.
 



 • Prepare weekly and monthly cash\-flow forecasts.
 



 • Closely monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables.
 



 • Work with Sales and Project teams to ensure collections happen as per agreed
 



 payment milestones.
 



 • Plan vendor payments based on cash\-flow requirements and business priorities.
 



 • Maintain healthy working capital while ensuring critical vendors and projects are
 



 adequately supported.
 



 • Identify potential cash\-flow gaps and proactively flag them to management.
 



 4\. Accounts Receivable \& Collections
 



 • Monitor customer receivables, ageing, and overdue payments.
 



 • Establish clear collection processes and escalation mechanisms.
 



 • Track project\-wise billing and collection milestones.
 



 • Coordinate with Sales and Project teams on pending customer payments.
 



 • Ensure customer advances and project payments are accurately accounted for and
 



 reconciled.
 



 5\. Accounts Payable \& Vendor Management
 



 • Oversee vendor and contractor payments and ensure proper documentation and
 



 approvals.
 



 • Establish financial controls around purchase orders, invoices, goods receipts, and
 



 payment approvals.
 



 • Monitor vendor outstanding and ageing.
 



 • Ensure payments are aligned with contractual terms and project cash flows.
 



 • Identify opportunities to improve payment terms and working capital.
 



 6\. Accounting, Compliance \& Controls
 



 • Oversee day\-to\-day accounting and ensure books are maintained accurately and on
 



 time.
 



 • Ensure timely GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and other statutory compliance.
 



 • Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and external advisors.
 



 • Manage monthly and annual financial closures.
 



 • Ensure timely bank, ledger, customer, and vendor reconciliations.
 



 • Strengthen internal financial controls and approval processes.
 



 • Identify financial risks, control gaps, and potential leakages and recommend
 



 corrective measures.
 



 7\. Internal Controls \& Process Improvement
 



 • Build robust SOPs and approval workflows for finance\-related processes.
 



 • Establish controls around procurement, project expenses, reimbursements, petty
 



 cash, and payments.
 



 • Implement systems to minimise financial leakages, errors, and unauthorised
 



 expenditure.
 



 • Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes wherever possible.
 



 • Ensure financial data is accurate, timely, and accessible to management.
 



 8\. Business Partnership
 



 • Act as a strategic finance partner to the management team.
 



 • Work closely with Operations, Procurement, Sales, and Project teams to improve
 



 financial performance.
 



 • Evaluate the financial impact of new business initiatives, pricing decisions, vendor
 



 contracts, and operational changes.

 Qualifications
 



 • CA/CMA preferred; candidates with strong relevant experience and qualifications in
 



 Finance/Accounting may also be considered.
 



 • 1 to 4 years of relevant experience, preferably in interiors, construction, real estate,

 capital.

 • Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.

 • Ability to work independently and build processes in a growing organisation.

 India, dedicated to transforming client ideas into customized, cost\-effective design solutions.
 



  





 The team combines strong design expertise with cutting\-edge technology to deliver end\-to\-
 



 end interior design and execution for both residential and commercial spaces. The company

title: Senior Analyst, Pricing Operations
description:
Our Purpose
   

  

 At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. **About Us**
 SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
   

  

 Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
   

  

**What Are We Looking For?**
 We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst, Pricing Programs \& Analytics
 **,** 
 you will sit at the intersection of commercial program execution and applied pricing analytics. You will own the operational mechanics that keep the Flex program running, the feedback loops and documentation that connect field reality to program design, and the deal\-level intelligence — performance reporting, price realization analysis, and trend identification — that translates data into decisions. You will work closely with Advanced Analytics, Deal Desk, Sales Enablement, and GTM Systems to ensure pricing programs are well\-run, well\-documented, and continuously improving.
   

  

**What Will You Do?**
 Primary responsibilities include
 **:**
* Flex Program Operations \& Administration
* Maintain and administer the day\-to\-day mechanics of the Flex program — including rule documentation, eligibility criteria, CPQ floor configurations, and Deal Desk guidance — ensuring program parameters are accurately reflected in systems and field\-facing materials.
* Own the Flex enhancement roadmap tracker: documenting Fast Follow and Future Enhancement items, tracking owner accountability, sequencing dependencies, and flagging items at risk of slipping across quarters.
* Coordinate cross\-functional follow\-through on approved enhancement items — tracking progress with IT, CPQ, Deal Desk, and Enablement without driving senior stakeholder conversations directly.
* Produce and maintain requirements documentation for CPQ and system changes — translating approved program changes into clear, executable specifications and coordinating Deal Desk validation once changes are built.
* Program Analytics \& Commercial Intelligence
* Consume outputs from the Pricing Guidance Engine to produce program\-level adoption and compliance reporting — tracking how Flex deals align to guidance corridors, where discounting concentrates, and how program participation correlates with deal outcomes such as win rates, deal velocity, and expansion rates.
* Build and maintain program\-specific performance views on top of Advanced Analytics' strategic baselines — including Flex attach rates, deal size distributions, remix frequency, and platform expansion patterns.
* Own price waterfall interpretation at the Flex program level — surfacing how Flex deals flow from list to net pocket price, identifying program\-specific margin leakage patterns, and feeding findings back to Advanced Analytics.
* Produce deal behavior analysis that connects Flex and commercial program participation to measurable field outcomes — equipping leadership with a clear picture of what the program is doing to deal quality, not just deal volume.
* Participate in the price realization process — measuring the gap between intended list pricing and what is actually collected after discounts, concessions, and program incentives are applied.
* Analyze transactional data to identify price realization trends and anomalies — by segment, route to market, geography, or deal type — and produce structured findings that distinguish systematic execution gaps from one\-off exceptions.
* Surface price realization insights that connect to program behavior — identifying how Flex participation and commercial program structures are influencing the spread between list and realized price.
* Field Feedback \& Program Intelligence
* Own the seller and partner feedback collection process — designing and distributing surveys, compiling results, and synthesizing field sentiment into organized summaries that leadership can act on.
* Maintain a running tracker of field feedback across Slack threads, Deal Desk escalations, and stakeholder calls — ensuring patterns are captured and recurring friction points are surfaced with supporting evidence.
* Build and maintain QBR materials for the Pricing Programs team, translating performance data and deal behavior analysis into structured, presentation\-ready assets for leadership review.
* Process Documentation \& Enablement Content
* Own the creation and ongoing maintenance of internal Flex process documentation — including step\-by\-step flows for remixes, debook/rebook migrations, and common field scenarios — published via Highspot with version control.
* Maintain the comprehensive internal Flex guide as the single source of truth for AEs, CSMs, Deal Desk, channel sellers, and new hires — keeping it current as program rules evolve.
* Maintain and refresh field\-facing program materials — including the seller cheat sheet, program one\-pagers, FAQs, and eligibility summaries — as pricing rules, thresholds, and features change.
* Support the development of sales motion\-specific enablement assets — including ICP materials, success story compilations, and deal structuring reference guides — working alongside Enablement and Product Marketing.


**What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**
 Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

* 4\+ years in pricing programs, revenue operations, sales operations, or a commercial analytics role within a SaaS environment.
* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to build and maintain performance datasets, interpret deal behavior data, and translate outputs into structured, actionable summaries.
* Experience producing and maintaining operational documentation — process flows, program guides, enablement materials — with a track record of keeping content current, version\-controlled, and well\-organized.
* Familiarity with CPQ systems and commercial program mechanics — including eligibility logic, quoting rules, and discount structures — sufficient to write clear system requirements and validate changes.
* Understanding of SaaS commercial models, including subscription, consumption, and hybrid structures, and how commercial vehicles like Flex operate in a field selling context.
* Proficiency with data tools (Excel, SQL, or BI platforms such as Looker or Tableau) to build program scorecards, deal behavior reports, and performance views on top of existing analytical baselines.
* Comfortable working within an established analytical framework — applying and extending existing models and baselines rather than building the intelligence layer independently.
* Excellent cross\-functional communication and coordination skills; able to work effectively with Sales, Deal Desk, Enablement, Advanced Analytics, IT, and Partner teams.
* High attention to detail and strong organizational discipline; able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams without items falling through the cracks.
* Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, or platform pricing is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce or Highspot is a plus.


**Why SentinelOne?**
 AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

title: Implementation Lead
description:
**Lead, Enterprise Onboarding** 




  





**ABOUT SHESHI** 




**Bringing Sanctity to Numbers** 




  





 Sheshi is a Financial Operating System, the governed infrastructure layer that converts raw financial data into results that organisations can completely trust. Governed, auditable, period\-locked, and traceable to the source.
 



  





 We are headquartered in Bangalore, building an enterprise\-grade product for the global market.
 



  





 Bringing an enterprise customer onto Sheshi is a complete undertaking, their entities need to be structured correctly, their chart of accounts and reporting hierarchies configured, their consolidation and multi\-currency setup built out, and their financial history brought in accurately where required. Every one of these has to be right, because everything the customer sees afterward is built on this foundation.
 



  





 As Lead, Enterprise Onboarding, you own this foundation end to end. You build the methodology this team runs on, stay hands\-on enough to solve the hardest configuration, consolidation, and reconciliation problems yourself, and lead a team of finance professionals who bring customers live with speed and precision.
 



  





**WHY SHESHI** 




  





**What Makes This Role Worth Doing** 




**Real ownership from day one.** 
 You design the methodology, own the portfolio, and are the final authority on go\-live readiness.
 



**Work that shapes how the customer experiences Sheshi.** 
 How an account is structured and configured determines whether the customer trusts what they see from day one.
 



**A team you build.** 
 You hire, coach, and grow a team of finance professionals, with real say in who joins and how they develop.
 



**Player\-coach by design.** 
 You stay hands\-on in the hardest problems, not just in the management of people who solve them.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**What You Will Own** 




  





**Account Structuring and Configuration** 



* Own how every enterprise account is structured on Sheshi, entity hierarchies, chart of accounts, reporting structures, and close settings.
* Design and own the configuration methodology for multi\-entity, multi\-GAAP, and multi\-currency customers, ensuring it is built correctly the first time.
* Personally lead structuring and configuration for the largest, most complex, or highest\-risk customer accounts.



**Consolidation Setup** 



* Own the approach to consolidation configuration, intercompany relationships, elimination rules, and group\-level reporting structure.
* Step in directly when a consolidation structure is genuinely complex or a customer's group structure does not fit standard patterns.



**Historical Data Migration and Validation** 



* Own the methodology for migrating historical MIS and statutory financials where a customer requires it — run as a real closing exercise, not a data dump.
* Own final sign\-off on historical data accuracy, entity configuration, and consolidation setup before any customer goes live.



**Portfolio Ownership and Reporting** 



* Maintain visibility across every customer currently onboarding , status, risk, and timeline for each, and report this honestly to the Customer Success Head.
* Decide where the team's effort goes when multiple customers are onboarding simultaneously and priorities compete.



**Team Building and Development** 



* Own hiring for the team, define what you are looking for, run interviews, and make the call on who joins.
* Run direct feedback and coaching with each team member on functional quality, customer handling, and pace.
* Give team members increasing ownership as they demonstrate readiness, there is no fixed ceiling on what a strong team member can grow into.



**Relationship Ownership Across Functions** 



* Be the primary point of contact for Sales and Presales when a deal being scoped will affect onboarding complexity or timeline.
* Own the relationship with Product and Engineering for platform gaps discovered during configuration or migration.
* Ensure a clean, well\-timed handover to Customer Success once a customer is fully live and validated.



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Your Background and Strengths** 




  





**Experience** 



* 6\-8 years in financial reporting, accounting, or financial systems implementation, with at least 3 years leading a team.
* Proven experience configuring and structuring financial systems for enterprise customers, chart of accounts, entity hierarchies, and reporting frameworks.
* Strong track record with multi\-entity consolidation and group reporting structures, hands\-on, not just oversight.
* Experience leading complex enterprise customer onboarding or implementation in a B2B SaaS or financial systems environment.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing a team of finance professionals.



**Functional Depth** 



* Strong command of Indian and international accounting standards — IndAS, IFRS, and multi\-GAAP reporting.
* Deep experience with multi\-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, group reporting structures, and multi\-currency translation.
* Comfortable configuring financial system, chart of accounts, reporting hierarchies, and close settings, for complex organisational structures.
* Ability to reconcile complex historical financial data with rigour and precision where migration is required.



**How You Work** 



* You stay hands\-on in the hardest problems, your team and your customers can count on you to solve what others cannot.
* You build systems and methodology, not just manage people through ad hoc work.
* You report honestly and early, no surprises for the Customer Success Head.
* You move at pace, bureaucracy and unnecessary delay have no place in how you run onboarding.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with SaaS implementation for enterprise financial or ERP systems.
* Exposure to multiple accounting frameworks across different customer geographies.
* Prior experience building a team or function from an early stage.

****Job Description****
 HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build
 **HPE Networking** 
 , with the ambition of creating the
 **best networking business on the planet** 
 . This role sits at the center of that effort as part of
 **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program** 
 , responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a
 **single platform** 
 , replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.
   

  

 As part of a fast\-moving,
 **multi\-year transformation** 
 , the team will stabilize near\-term operations,
 **migrate core** 
**platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally** 
 , and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with
 **business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** 
 on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.
   

  

 For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help
 **build a new business unit from its earliest days** 
 , rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain
 **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership** 
 , with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.
   

  

**Workstream\-Specific Details**

****Responsibilities****
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation, configuration, enhancement, and production support of Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) systems.
* Own and manage RAR system capabilities supporting revenue accounting, revenue recognition, contract accounting, performance obligations, revenue allocation, deferrals, accruals, adjustments, and revenue reporting.
* Partner with the Finance Solution Architect to design and optimize RAR solutions aligned with business requirements, Finance strategy, and enterprise architecture.
* Collaborate with Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Sales, Order Management, Billing, CPQ, Tax, Legal, IT, and other cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and develop effective system solutions.
* Design and configure SAP RAR solutions to support complex revenue accounting and recognition requirements.
* Ensure RAR solutions comply with IFRS 15, ASC 606, applicable accounting policies, SOX, and internal control requirements.
* Support complex revenue scenarios including multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, standalone selling price allocation, contract assets, contract liabilities, revenue deferrals, and adjustments.
* Manage integrations between RAR and SAP S/4HANA Finance, SD, Billing, Order Management, CPQ, CRM, Contract Management, Tax, and third\-party applications.
* Ensure accurate and reliable data flow from sales/order → contract → billing → RAR → General Ledger → financial reporting.
* Lead system testing activities including SIT, UAT, integration testing, regression testing, and release validation.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex production issues impacting Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
* Perform root\-cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions for recurring system and revenue accounting issues.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and year\-end revenue close and reporting activities.
* Partner with Finance and Accounting teams to investigate and resolve revenue reconciliation issues between source systems, billing, RAR, subledger, and General Ledger.
* Ensure system changes comply with SOX, internal controls, audit requirements, security policies, and change management standards.
* Support internal and external audits by providing system documentation, configuration details, control evidence, and remediation support.
* Develop and maintain documentation covering system configuration, revenue accounting rules, business processes, integrations, testing, controls, and operational procedures.
* Provide user training, guidance, and subject matter expertise to Finance and Revenue Accounting teams.
* Drive continuous improvement and standardization of RAR processes and system capabilities across business units and regions.
* Identify opportunities for automation, workflow optimization, reconciliation automation, reporting improvements, and reduction of manual Finance activities.
* Monitor SAP product releases, accounting standard changes, regulatory requirements, and industry trends and recommend appropriate system enhancements.
* Lead adoption of new SAP RAR capabilities and industry best practices.
* Work with application support teams and implementation partners to establish effective L1/L2/L3 support, knowledge management, monitoring, and operational governance.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to Finance systems analysts, support teams, and external partners.
* Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives involving RAR modernization, SAP S/4HANA, process standardization, automation, and Finance technology simplification.


****Education And Experience Required****
* 10–14 years of relevant experience in Finance Systems, SAP, or enterprise Finance technology.
* 4–6\+ years of hands\-on experience with SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR).


****Knowledge And Skills****
* Extensive experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and Revenue Accounting and Reporting.
* Strong understanding of Revenue Recognition principles, including IFRS 15 and ASC 606\.
* Deep knowledge of revenue accounting concepts including performance obligations, transaction price, variable consideration, standalone selling price, revenue allocation, contract assets and liabilities, deferrals, accruals, and contract modifications.
* Proven experience implementing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP RAR in a large enterprise environment.
* Strong experience integrating RAR with SAP SD, FI, Billing, Order Management, CPQ, CRM, and third\-party applications.
* Strong understanding of Order\-to\-Cash / Quote\-to\-Cash processes and their impact on Revenue Accounting.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end revenue data flows from transaction through billing, RAR, General Ledger, and financial reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and production support.
* Strong experience with revenue reconciliation and financial close processes.
* Experience supporting complex global revenue models and regional accounting requirements.
* Strong understanding of SOX, internal controls, audit requirements, and Finance compliance.
* Proven experience in incident, problem, change, and release management for business\-critical Finance applications.
* Experience leading Finance systems transformation, enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Knowledge of Finance automation, workflow, analytics, and digital transformation is desirable.
* Proven ability to design and deliver complex, integrated Finance solutions at enterprise scale.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with Finance, Accounting, Business, IT, Architecture, and external partners.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst - Procurement
description:
**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Equinix is seeking a highly motivated
 **Senior Business Systems Analyst** 
 to join our Bangalore office. In this role, you will serve as the functional and systems expert for Source to Pay processes and technology solutions, partnering closely with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to drive process excellence and digital transformation.
   

  

 You will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, designing scalable P2P solutions, optimizing Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, and supporting global procurement initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion with exceptional analytical, stakeholder management, and solution design skills.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering business value through process standardization, automation, system enhancements, integrations, and adoption of best\-in\-class procurement practices that support Equinix's global operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Financials and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes across global business units.
   

  

  Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Operations, and IT stakeholders to gather, analyze, document, and prioritize business requirements.
   

  

  Translate business requirements into functional designs, process improvements, solution architectures, and implementation roadmaps.
   

  

  Lead end\-to\-end Oracle Cloud/EBS functional initiatives spanning Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, General Ledger integration points, Supplier Risk Management, Purchasing, and Financial Operations.
   

  

  Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, controls, compliance, and operational efficiency.
   

  

  Analyze current\-state business processes and identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, and digital transformation across finance and procurement functions.
   

  

  Facilitate requirements workshops, fit\-gap analyses, solution design sessions, process mapping exercises, and stakeholder reviews.
   

  

  Configure, support, and enhance Oracle Financials and Procurement modules, including system testing, deployment, and post\-production support.
   

  

  Collaborate with technical teams, integration teams, reporting teams, and third\-party vendors to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.
   

  

  Support and coordinate integrations between Oracle ERP and upstream/downstream systems, including banking, supplier, tax, reporting, and other enterprise applications.
   

  

  Lead data conversion, reconciliation, system validation, SIT/UAT testing, defect resolution, and change management activities during implementations and enhancements.
   

  

  Develop and maintain business process documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and operational procedures.
   

  

  Design and support reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics that provide visibility into financial and operational performance.
   

  

  Partner with business leaders to recommend best\-practice solutions aligned with Oracle capabilities, governance standards, and evolving business needs.
   

  

  Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution of functional and process\-related challenges.
   

  

  Support period\-end close activities, financial controls, audit requirements, and compliance initiatives related to P2P processes.
   

  

  Provide mentorship to junior analysts and consultants while contributing to functional competency development across Finance and ERP domains.
   

  

  Stay current with Oracle ERP capabilities, emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices across Finance, P2P, and enterprise business processes.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
  Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

  8\+ years of experience as an Oracle Functional Consultant, Business Systems Analyst, ERP Analyst, or Functional Lead supporting Finance and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) business processes.
   

  

  Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle ERP Cloud and/or Oracle E\-Business Suite, including Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Supplier Management, General Ledger integrations, and Procurement modules.
   

  

  Deep understanding of end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable (AP), Supplier Management, Financial Controls, and ERP business processes.
   

  

  Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications, process designs, configuration solutions, and implementation roadmaps.
   

  

  Proven track record leading Oracle ERP implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and business transformation initiatives.
   

  

  Strong knowledge of finance and procurement controls, approval workflows, compliance requirements, audit support, and business governance practices.
   

  

  Experience supporting enterprise application integrations between Oracle ERP, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Banking, Tax, and third\-party systems.
   

  

  Hands\-on experience with configuration, testing, SIT/UAT coordination, defect management, production support, and release management activities.
   

  

  Strong understanding of Oracle reporting, analytics, dashboards, and KPI development to support business decision\-making.
   

  

  Experience with data conversion, data migration, reconciliation, and master data management activities.
   

  

  Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and business process improvement skills.
   

  

  Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery environments.
   

  

  Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
   

  

  Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.
   

  

  Oracle Cloud certification in Procurement, Financials, or related Oracle ERP modules is preferred.
   

  

  Experience leading or supporting Oracle Cloud ERP implementation and transformation programs.
   

  

  Knowledge of complementary enterprise applications such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Ivalua, GEP, Concur, BlackLine, or other finance/procurement platforms is a plus.
   

  

  Experience with integrations, APIs, middleware platforms, and enterprise architecture frameworks.
   

  

  Strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, and Shared Services business processes.
   

  

  Experience supporting month\-end close, financial operations, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives.
   

  

  Project management, change management, and stakeholder engagement experience preferred.
   

  

 How You will find success
   

  

* Cultivate a strong sense of curiosity and a product\-focused mindset.
* Collaborate effectively with managers, cross\-functional teams, and teammates to achieve shared goals.
* Demonstrate persistence, creativity, and an unwavering drive to deliver results.
* Take pride in ownership and consistently strive for excellence in every initiative.
