title: EYP - Corp Strategy - Associate Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Associate Manager – Strategy**
 As part of our EY\-Parthenon team, you will help clients develop their growth and investment strategies and evaluate potential transactions. Working with EY\-Parthenon’s proprietary frameworks, you will help clients to take steps the best way to raise, invest, optimize, and preserve their capital. This includes developing growth and market entry strategies and conducting strategic portfolio reviews. The client base spans across industries and includes blue chip corporates, multinational investors, and Private Equity firms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for Associate Manager, with expertise in Strategy Consulting to join the spearheading group of our EY\-Parthenon Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a prominent firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Use an answer first approach to deliver growth, market and portfolio strategy engagements for corporates
* Spearhead a team of 3\-7 professionals undertaking corporate strategy studies
* Support business development activities through both spearheading pursuits and developing strong relationships with existing clients
* Participate in building a sector focused practice across EY service lines; Specialization in a specific sector will be an added advantage
* Contribute in development of intellectual capital in your industry of expertise
* Be a part of case teams to provide solutions to unstructured problems


**Experience And Skills For Success**
* Growth strategy/ Market entry assessment
* Go\-to\-market strategy
* Strategic options study
* Portfolio \& corporate strategy
* Business model redesign
* Strategic cost evaluation
* Digital \& innovation strategy
* Clear articulation of thoughts and structured problem solving
* Experience of working with global stakeholders


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Experience in executing and managing strategy consulting engagements, client engagement skills and expertise in delivering strategic insights on accounts and sectors
* Integrate AI and advanced analytics into core client problem solving across strategy, operations, growth, and transformation topics
* Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, create insights, and improve team productivity while ensuring quality and rigor
* Knowledge of databases such as CapIQ, Thomson etc.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, exposure to tools like Power BI, Alteryx, working knowledge of VBA, Python will be a plus
* Master’s degree


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Exposure to tools like Power Bi, Alteryx etc.


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-prominent, multi\-disciplinary team of 3000 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Summary**
 As Offer Procurement Leader (Specialist, Offer Lifecycle Procurement), you streamline procurement processes to create competitive offers aligned with business objectives. You work closely with product and offer managers to identify procurement needs, source materials and services for new offers, and negotiate cost\-effective contracts with suppliers. Your mission is to ensure the efficient and timely procurement of resources essential for developing compelling offers.
   

  

 The core of the role is fact\-based cost ownership. You develop should\-cost models and detailed cost breakdowns for mechanical components — sheet metal parts, steel tubes, copper tubes, fabricated assemblies, machined parts and welded structures — and use them to support commercial negotiations, supplier cost analysis, value engineering and cost reduction across the offer lifecycle. You give the sourcing team data\-driven insight into manufacturing cost, material cost, labour content and conversion cost.
   

  

 You work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing and Suppliers to identify cost optimisation opportunities and improve overall supply chain competitiveness.
   

  

 As an individual contributor you execute operational and functional strategies within the procurement discipline, applying specialised knowledge to deliver results that directly impact offer creation. You decide on your own work and priorities within established policies and procedures, guide other professionals on non\-routine procurement issues, and your work is occasionally reviewed for quality against organisational standards.

 Develop detailed should\-cost models for:
   

  

* Sheet metal components
* Steel tube assemblies
* Copper tube components
* Fabricated and welded structures
* Machined components
* Powder\-coated parts
* Mechanical assemblies
* Manufacturing Process Analysis


 Analyse manufacturing processes and their cost drivers, including:
   

  

* Laser cutting, turret punching and bending
* Welding and brazing
* Tube bending and tube forming
* Machining
* Powder coating
* Cost Estimation


 Build up and estimate:
   

  

* Raw material cost
* Conversion cost
* Labour cost
* Overheads and profit
* Machine hour rates
* Packing and freight cost
* Procurement Support
* Support sourcing teams during supplier negotiations through fact\-based cost analysis.

* Design\-to\-cost initiatives

* Offer Lifecycle Ownership
* Collaborate with product and offer managers to identify procurement needs for new offers at the earliest project stage.
* Source and procure the materials and services required to develop new offers, and secure supplier selection against project gates.
* Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers to ensure cost\-effective offer creation.
* Ensure the target cost committed at project launch is achieved and maintained through the offer lifecycle.

* The Professional, Process Analyst job maps, documents, and analyzes processes in alignment with policies, external requirements and business process management standards and tools. With limited supervision, this job provides valuable insights into process performance to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.


 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* PROCESS DESIGN: Maps, analyzes and updates existing processes applying business process management standards and tools, and performs process modeling to design current and future state business processes to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.
* TECHNOLOGY ENABLEMENT: Applies practical knowledge of the processes, variations and dependencies to support process deployment and stabilize process after technology deployments.
* PROCESS DOCUMENTATION \& TRAINING: Creates and maintains work instructions, job aids and overall process training material in compliance with the business process management standards, partners to deliver specific training and materials to target audience, and documents processes in official business process management tools.
* PROCESS GOVERNANCE: Analyzes process variation, tracks adoption of business process management standards, and partners to adopt taxonomy changes and documentation updates.
* STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENT \& CHANGE IMPACT: Partners to deploy approved process changes, updating documents and supporting adoption. Partners with internal and external stakeholders to provide and solicit feedback to improve process change management and operational efficiency and effectiveness.
* PROCESS PERFORMANCE: Provides digital and analytical reporting, including analyzing performance metrics, identifying gaps and trends, and advising on the quality of existing processes.
* PROCESS IMPROVEMENT: Researches, interviews and observes processes to gain insight into current workflows, partners to identify potential inefficiencies, and provides inputs to improve process efficiency, effectiveness and user experience.


**Qualifications**

* Minimum requirement of 4 years of relevant work experience. Typically reflects 4\+ years or more of relevant experience.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Proven ability to manage multiple initiatives, influence stakeholders and support organizational change in a global environment across functions.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Certification is preferred.
* Knowledge of CTC and the corresponding Enterprise is preferred.
* Experience in Finance Operations, particularly Credit\-to\-Cash (C2C), Order\-to\-Cash (O2C).

* Experience with digital transformation initiatives.

 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 This role will be based in Bangalore, India. At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 Hiring Team Description
   

  





 We are seeking a Finance AI \& Automation Engineer to design, build, and scale AI\-enabled workflows and internal applications that change how Finance operates. This role is AI\-first and build\-heavy: you will ship production workflows that combine approved AI services with low\-code platforms (Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate), integrate with enterprise systems including Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, GetPaid, and Allocadia, and apply automation patterns to eliminate manual work.
   

  





 You will partner closely with stakeholders across Finance \- Strategic Finance, FP\&A, Controllership, Procurement, Marketing Finance, and Collections \- to identify pain points, translate them into product requirements, and ship iterative solutions with strong reliability, governance, and responsible AI practices.
   

  





 Core Responsibilities
   

  





 AI\-Enabled Workflow Design
   

  




* Lead with AI: design and ship Finance workflows that use approved AI services for classification, summarization, anomaly detection, narrative generation, assisted triage, and knowledge search.


* Partner with security, privacy, and platform teams to apply guardrails, prompt patterns, evaluation harnesses, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.


* Define success metrics (cycle time, accuracy, deflection rate) and instrument solutions so AI value is measurable.



 Low\-Code / No\-Code Application Development
   

  




* Build and deploy production applications using Microsoft Power Apps (canvas / model\-driven) and Power Automate, with user\-friendly interfaces and role\-based experiences.


* Deliver rapid iterations with engineering discipline: versioning, environments, release practices, and quality checks.


* Create reusable components, templates, and patterns to accelerate delivery across multiple Finance use cases.



 Workflow Automation \& Process Orchestration
   

  




* Automate end\-to\-end Finance processes: request intake, approvals, task routing, exception handling, audit trail, and notifications.


* Target touchless and low\-touch outcomes (e.g., PO lifecycle, expense workflows, close tasks, marketing allocation).


* Optimize for scalability, reliability, and maintainability \- reducing manual steps, cycle times, and operational toil.



 Integrations \& Data Connectivity
   

  




* Build and maintain integrations between low\-code apps and enterprise systems (Oracle Fusion ERP, Oracle EPM, GetPaid, Allocadia, and adjacent platforms).


* Implement data validations, lightweight transformations, and robust error handling for accuracy and operational resilience.


* Partner with IT and Data teams on integration standards, authentication, and governance.



 Quality, Operations, and Support
   

  




* Own testing and debugging: functional validation, performance checks, regression testing, and production issue triage.


* Monitor application performance and usage; improve speed, stability, and user experience.


* Provide tier\-2 support, runbooks, and documentation to ensure smooth adoption.



 Product Mindset \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  




* Run discovery with Finance stakeholders, translate needs into clear user stories, and manage a prioritized backlog.


* Communicate progress, trade\-offs, and decisions; demo iteratively and adapt based on outcomes.



 Governance, Security, and Documentation
   

  




* Ensure applications meet enterprise standards for data protection, access controls, auditability, change management, and AI responsible\-use policies.


* Produce clear technical documentation (solution design, integrations, configuration) and user guides.


**Qualifications**

 Basic Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience).


* 10\+ years of relevant professional experience, or equivalent experience.


* Hands\-on experience building production solutions with Microsoft Power Apps or another low\-code / no\-code platform.


* Demonstrated experience applying AI in production workflows \- at minimum, prompt engineering, evaluation, and responsible\-use practices for enterprise AI services.


* Understanding of software delivery fundamentals (SDLC, environments, testing, releases).


* Experience translating business requirements into working applications and workflows.



 Preferred Qualifications
   

  




* Experience integrating low\-code applications with enterprise platforms such as Oracle Fusion ERP, Oracle EPM, GetPaid, or Allocadia (APIs, data connectors, authentication patterns).


* Experience with AI\-enabled automation use cases at scale \- document intelligence, summarization, anomaly detection, narrative generation, conversational interfaces.

* Familiarity with automation tooling and workflow orchestration (approvals, exception handling, notifications, audit trail).

* FP\&A

You thrive in cross\-functional environments, take end\-to\-end ownership, and balance speed with reliability, security, and maintainability. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.
   

  

**Role Summary :**
 BKNG Treasury is seeking a proactive, self\-starting professional to drive the execution of global Treasury activities. In this role, you will lead efforts across bank account management, banking administration, and automated TMS static data management. Initially focused on supporting one of the verticals in our global banking structure, the role will evolve to encompass broader TMS data ownership and operational leadership within our maturing treasury framework.
   

  

 As a vital member of the BKNG Treasury team, you will collaborate with cross\-functional partners in Banking, Technology, Legal, and Risk. This position demands exceptional coordination, disciplined execution, and a passion for process standardization as we transition key operations to our Bangalore Center of Excellence (CoE).
   

  

 You will be expected to champion continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process optimization, strengthening internal controls, and enhancing data governance across our global banking partnerships and treasury platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities :**
* Bank Account Management
* Manage and optimize the global bank account inventory, ensuring rigorous oversight for in\-scope entities.
* Facilitate end\-to\-end bank account lifecycles, including openings, modifications, and closures, by coordinating internal approvals and external partner requirements.
* Ensure bank account records, account attributes, signer information, and related supporting documentation remain complete and accurate.
* Track account lifecycle events and ensure timely follow\-up on pending requests with internal stakeholders and external banking partners.
* Support the maintenance of centralized repositories for bank account documentation, agreements, and supporting records.


 Banking Administration
   

  

* Execute core banking administration activities including KYC support, signatory management, bank form administration, and documentation handling for in\-scope entities.
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and business stakeholders to collect and validate required documentation for bank requests and periodic reviews.
* Manage updates to mandates, signer structures, bank contacts, and related documentation across the banking landscape.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of required information to banking partners in line with regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.
* Monitor outstanding bank requests and escalations, and provide clear status updates to stakeholders


 TMS Static Data Management
   

  

* Act as the primary owner for treasury static data within the TMS, overseeing counterparties, settlement instructions, and master data integrity.
* Ensure all static data changes are completed accurately, approved appropriately, and recorded in line with control and governance requirements.
* Support the automation and standardization of static data maintenance processes to reduce manual intervention and improve data quality.
* Perform data quality reviews and reconciliations between the TMS, banking platforms, and supporting source documentation.
* Partner with Treasury Technology and other teams on system enhancements, issue resolution, testing, and process improvements related to static data management.


 Banking Operations
   

  

* Support selected banking operations activities including payment investigations, proof of payment requests, bank query resolution, and follow\-up on operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with internal teams and banking partners to investigate payment issues, confirm transaction status, and resolve operational incidents within agreed timelines.

description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Objectives / Purpose:**
 We are seeking a Principal Analyst to join Takeda's GCC Commercial Analytics \& Insights (CA\&I) organization in India as part of the Forecasting capability supporting International Business Units (IBU). This is a senior individual contributor and technical lead role for analysts who have mastered the full forecasting toolkit and now set the analytical standard for the pod. The Principal Analyst owns the most complex, high\-visibility forecasts across Ex\-US markets \- including patient\-based prevalence and disease\-progression models, demand\-based models, and hybrid launch and long\-range forecasts \- serves as the go\-to methodology expert, and mentors’ junior analysts while remaining hands\-on. The role is accountable for model quality, methodology selection, and the analytical credibility of forecasting output delivered into brand planning, S\&OP, and portfolio cycles.
   

  

**Accountabilities:**
**Advanced Forecast Development and Technical Leadership:**
* Own the design and delivery of the most complex and strategically important forecasts across multiple IBU markets and brands, spanning short\-term tactical, long\-term strategic (10\+ years), in\-line, pipeline and BD forecasts.
* Serve as the pod's methodology expert across the full toolkit \- patient\-based models (prevalence, incidence, disease progression), demand\-based models (trend, time\-series, regression, exponential smoothing), and hybrid approaches \- and set the standard for which method fits each business question and data context.
* Lead sophisticated scenario, sensitivity, and risk analyses for competitive entries, LOEs, pricing and access changes, indication expansions, and cross\-market events, quantifying uncertainty and framing decision options.
* Define and enforce assumption documentation, version control, peer\-review, and audit\-trail standards for the pod, ensuring reproducibility and stakeholder\-ready quality.
* Own forecast accuracy governance \- designing variance\-tracking approaches, diagnosing drivers of deviation, and institutionalizing learnings into improved drivers and assumption libraries.


**Data, Methodology, and Innovation:**
* Establish best practices for working with IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, syndicated subnational data, claims, prescription data, and epidemiology sources to build robust market and patient views across Ex\-US geographies.
* Evaluate and introduce advanced statistical and machine learning techniques \- including ARIMA, exponential smoothing, multivariate regression, Prophet, and other time\-series methods \- to improve forecast accuracy and efficiency.
* Design reusable model templates, assumption libraries, and dashboard frameworks in Excel, Tableau or Power BI, and where applicable Python or R, that raise the productivity and consistency of the entire pod.


**Stakeholder Partnership and Influence:**
* Act as a trusted analytical advisor to affiliate forecasting leads, brand teams, finance, and global IBU stakeholders, shaping how forecasting questions are framed and answered.
* Translate complex model outputs into decision\-grade narratives, slides, and assumption summaries for commercial, finance, and senior leadership audiences.
* Represent the GCC forecasting pod as a subject\-matter expert in brand planning, forecast review, S\&OP, LRP, and ad\-hoc strategic forums.


**Mentorship and Operational Excellence:**
* Mentor Analysts and Senior Analysts through technical coaching, model reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the analytical bar across the pod without formal people\-management responsibility.
* Drive automation and standardization initiatives across recurring forecasting workflows, applying AI and GenAI tools to accelerate assumption research, deviation reasoning, narrative generation, and documentation.
* Contribute to onboarding, best\-practice documentation, and capability\-building programs for the GCC IBU forecasting team.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience:**
**Education:**
* Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in Analytics, Economics, Data Science, Business, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
* Relevant certifications in forecasting, analytics, cloud platforms, or statistical methods are a plus.


**Experience:**
* 5\-6 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical forecasting or related quantitative areas, with a track record of owning complex forecasts independently.
* Deep hands\-on experience building the full range of forecast types \- including prevalence and disease\-progression (patient\-based) models and demand\-based models, across short\-term and long\-term, in\-line and launch horizons \- across multiple markets.
* Experience supporting Ex\-US markets is required, particularly EU markets; exposure to Asian or Latin American markets is a strong plus.
* Strong working knowledge of pharma data assets such as IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, prescription and claims data, and epidemiology sources for Ex\-US markets.
* Advanced Excel skills for forecast model construction are required; demonstrated ability to design reusable templates and frameworks.
* Strong experience with Tableau or Power BI for forecast tracking, scenario reporting, and commercial performance dashboard development.
* Familiarity with cloud analytics environments (Databricks, AWS, Azure) and forecasting platforms (e.g., Anaplan, JDA/Blue Yonder, SAP IBP) is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a methodology reference point and to mentor less experienced analysts.
* Proficiency in coding techniques such as Python, R, or SAS for time\-series analysis, automation, and reproducibility is a nice to have, not a mandatory requirement.


**Skills \& Competencies:**
* **Forecasting Methodology Mastery –:** 
 Recognized expert in selecting and applying patient\-based (prevalence, disease\-progression), demand\-based, and hybrid approaches; sets the methodology standard for the pod.
* **Technical Leadership –:** 
 Elevates the analytical rigor of the team through peer review, template design, and hands\-on problem solving on the hardest forecasts.
* **Pharmaceutical Domain Depth –:** 
 Deep command of demand drivers, patient flow, lifecycle stages, and competitive dynamics across therapy areas and Ex\-US markets.
* **Analytical Rigor –:** 
 Institutionalizes disciplined assumption management, sensitivity analysis, and accuracy governance across deliverables.
* **Stakeholder Influence –:** 
 Shapes how forecasting questions are framed and trusted as an analytical advisor by affiliate, brand, finance, and global partners.
* **Data Storytelling –:** 
 Distils complex forecast outputs, assumptions, and scenarios into clear, decision\-grade narratives.
* **Mentorship –:** 
 Coaches and develops junior analysts' technical skills and forecasting judgment.
* **Cross\-Cultural Communication –:** 
 Fluent communicator across India\-EU\-Asia\-LatAm time zones and organizational levels.


**TAKEDA LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS:**
 In alignment with Takeda’s Values\-Based Culture, this role requires demonstration of the following leadership behaviours
   

  

* Act with Integrity — Deliver accurate, transparent work and take full responsibility for quality.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally — Contribute positively to GCC\-IBU team workflows and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Drive Accountability — Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
* Embrace Learning — Continuously build analytical and domain capabilities through feedback and self\-driven development.

**GLOBAL BANKING \& MARKETS**


We make markets in and clear client transactions on major stock, options and futures exchanges worldwide. Through our global sales force, we maintain relationships with our clients, receiving orders and distributing investment research, trading ideas, market information and analysis.


**OPERATIONS**


Operations is a dynamic, multi\-faceted division that partners with all parts of the firm to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients around the world. In addition, Operations provides essential risk management and controls to preserve and enhance the firm's assets and its reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develops and manages the processes and controls that enable business flow.

  

FICC Operations Team is responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of risk undertaken by the FICC Business across the world. Team works very closely with Sales and Trading teams to facilitate all aspects of Operational Risk and Control Framework. The functions involve:


* Matching \& settlement of all trades – Vanilla \& complex
* Facilitating new business \& transformation initiatives
* Confirming economic and legal terms of trades with clients electronically and on paper
  

**YOUR IMPACT**


We are looking for a professional and dynamic individual with a strong interest in Global banking \& market operations The ideal candidate would be able to excel in a high\-profile and fast paced team whose primary responsibilities include (i) partnering with the Sales and Trading Desks to ensure the integrity and accuracy of risks undertaken by such businesses, as well as (ii) driving and implementing change to ensure we are optimally managing and monitoring risks, in an increasingly demanding and complex regulatory environment.

  

**JOB SUMMARY \& RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Develop a deep knowledge of derivative transactions
* Find and resolve booking discrepancies across complex derivative businesses
* Daily interaction with Trading \& Sales to ensure discrepancies are resolved immediately

* Manage, monitor and investigate reporting breaks and process failures; identify and implement corrective actions
* Ensure that processes are continually reviewed and improved, risk is managed, and results are achieved that meet expectations for timeliness, quality and cost effectiveness within the department
  

**PREFFERED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Demonstrated attention to detail in previous role on an ongoing basis
* Experience in understanding and breaking down complex structured products would be a big plus
* Team player with a collaborative style and strong interpersonal skills
* Effectively handle difficult requests, build long\-term relationships with the business and be able to manage expectations
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to be clear and concise
* Self\-starter who thinks ahead, anticipates questions, finds alternative solutions and identifies clear objectives
* Able to successfully multi\-task, work towards extremely challenging goals and persist in the face of obstacles
* Able to adapt to changes and new challenges
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, critical thinking, and an ability to suggest improvements and identify risks
* Service orientation, sense of urgency, ability to manage internal clients’ expectations and professionalism

title: Payroll Accountant
description:
**The Company**
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
   

  

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 PayPal seeks an experienced Payroll Accountant to join the Controllership Global Payroll Accounting team supporting the APJ, EMEA, North American and Latin American region. The successful candidate will work well in a fast\-paced environment, learn quickly, and possess strong payroll accounting expertise. The ability to manage relationships cross\-functionally through clear communication of goals and objectives is extremely important.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Key Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will execute and manage complex monthly close activities, including:
   

  

* Prepare account fluctuation analysis, identify key drivers, and explain monthly and quarterly activity. Maintain S4 BW account fluctuation reports.
* Reconcile payroll GL accounts including the payroll funding cash clearing account.
* Perform clearing for open item managed accounts.
* Prepare account fluctuation analysis, identify key drivers, and explain monthly and quarterly activity.
* Follow process for clearing payment activity for taxes on stock vesting and other clearing activity processed by payroll. Research offsets and how to clear where needed. Review monthly activity to ensure adherence to regular clearing.
* Monitor and assist in resolving issues with interface activity between payroll and accounting systems. This includes maintaining support for manual correction of interfaces.
* Develop a strong understanding of payroll and GL systems and processes. Maintain documentation of these systems and processes.
* Assist with research and resolution of payroll issues. Communicate and document clearly and concisely results of research or resolutions to issues.
* Assist Payroll Operations Team with changes to GL account mapping, testing, and implementation.
* Provide payroll analysis and documentation for support of audits.
* Process SAP assessments for global fringe benefits. Monitor and validate results from the fringe process.
* Record, prepare, and post numerous recurring and one\-time journal entries.

 At ADM India Hub, we are hiring for IT and finance roles across diverse technology and business functions. We stand at the intersection of global expertise and local excellence, enabling us to drive innovation and support our larger purpose of unlocking the power of nature to enrich quality of life.
 



  





**Job Title: FP\&A Analyst** 




**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
 



**Department:** 
 Finance
 



**Job Summary:** 




 The FP\&A Analyst is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of executive reporting at one of the world’s leading agricultural companies. As part of the dedicated reporting team within Corporate FP\&A, the FP\&A Analyst will play a key role in the design, build, and ongoing enhancement of executive\-level reports and dashboards within CXO, ADM’s online reporting and visualization platform. Working closely with FP\&A domain teams, Global Technology (GT), and senior finance leadership, the FP\&A Analyst, CXO will translate complex financial data into dynamic, actionable C\-level insights that drive strategic decision\-making across the organization, ensuring that reporting outputs are accurate, timely, and aligned with the evolving needs of executive stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the design and build of executive\-level reports and dashboards within CXO, ensuring outputs deliver clear, dynamic insights to C\-level stakeholders.
* Partner with FP\&A domain teams (FP\&A, Business Finance, Accounting, Treasury) to gather reporting requirements and translate them into scalable CXO solutions.
* Maintain and continuously enhance existing CXO reports, incorporating feedback from senior leadership and business partners to improve clarity, usability, and accuracy.
* Collaborate with Global Technology (GT) to manage data integrations, resolve system issues, and ensure seamless connectivity between CXO and source systems (e.g., Hyperion, Databricks).
* Conduct quality assurance and validation of reporting outputs to ensure data integrity and consistency across all CXO dashboards and reports.
* Support the rollout of new CXO reporting capabilities, including user training, documentation, and change management activities.
* Identify opportunities to automate and streamline reporting workflows within CXO to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Act as a trusted reporting resource for senior finance leadership, delivering ad hoc analysis and insights that support timely, informed decision\-making.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field.
* **4\-6 years of experience in FP\&A** 
 , financial reporting, or business intelligence, preferably within a large, global organization.
* Hands\-on experience with EPM or financial reporting tools; familiarity with CXO, Hyperion, Power BI, or similar platforms strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial planning and analysis concepts, including budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.
* Proficiency in data analysis and financial modeling, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and present findings clearly to senior audiences.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and reporting quality.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.



  





**Preferred Skills:** 



* Direct experience building or administering reports and dashboards in CXO or a comparable online reporting and visualization environment.
* Experience in the agriculture, food ingredients, or manufacturing industries.
* Familiarity with Hyperion and its related platforms (e.g., Essbase) and experience running SmartView queries.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high\-quality outputs in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience working in a Global Capability Center (GCC) or shared services finance environment.

 Experience in a strategic finance function at a high\-growth tech company, preferably in the payments/fintech space

This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

title: Treasury Manager
description:
**This role is for one of Weekday's clients
   

  

 Salary range: Rs 2000000 \- Rs 3500000 (ie INR 20 \- 35 LPA)**
 Min Experience: 10\+ years
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
   

  

 JobType: full\-time
   

  

 We are seeking a meticulous, proactive, and experienced
 **Treasury Manager** 
 to oversee day\-to\-day treasury operations, payment processing, cash management, banking relationships, and financial controls.
   

  

 The role will have a strong focus on
 **cheque\-based and manual payment processes** 
 , ensuring timely execution of critical transactions while maintaining accurate documentation, regulatory compliance, and strong relationships with banking partners.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in treasury operations, corporate banking, payment processing, cash flow management, and coordinating with internal stakeholders and financial institutions.
   

  

****Requirements****
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Cheque Management \& Payment Processing**
* Oversee the preparation, tracking, and processing of cheques for vendor payments, payroll, and other business disbursements
* Coordinate with authorized internal signatories to ensure timely cheque signing and completion of required documentation
* Maintain accurate physical and digital records of cheque transactions with complete audit trails
* Monitor payment schedules and ensure critical payments are executed within defined timelines
* Coordinate manual and digital payment processes while maintaining strong operational controls


**Banking \& Relationship Management**
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with branch managers and key contacts across partner banks
* Act as the primary point of contact for day\-to\-day banking and treasury requirements
* Coordinate with banks to facilitate timely and prioritized processing of critical transactions
* Resolve banking and transaction\-related queries, including fund transfers, cheque clearances, payment issues, and escalations
* Coordinate with multiple banking partners to ensure smooth and uninterrupted treasury operations


**Treasury Operations \& Cash Management**
* Monitor daily cash flows and ensure adequate fund availability across bank accounts
* Plan and manage cash requirements for cheque issuance, vendor payments, payroll, and other disbursements
* Monitor account balances and coordinate fund movements as required
* Ensure all treasury transactions comply with internal policies, authorization matrices, and financial controls
* Support month\-end and year\-end financial closing through treasury reports, reconciliations, and supporting documentation


**Compliance \& Controls**
* Ensure treasury transactions comply with applicable regulatory and statutory requirements
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for all financial instruments and transactions
* Safeguard the confidentiality and security of cheques, banking information, and other financial documentation
* Support internal and external audits by providing relevant treasury records and reconciliations
* Identify operational risks and strengthen treasury controls where required


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, or a related field
* 10\-15 years of experience in Treasury Operations, Corporate Finance, Banking Operations, or a related function
* Strong hands\-on experience managing cheque\-based and manual payment processes
* Strong understanding of banking operations, payment processing, and treasury procedures
* Prior experience managing relationships with multiple banking partners
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, and relationship management skills
* Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and follow\-up capabilities
* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic accounting systems such as Tally
* Exposure to ERP\-based financial and treasury systems is an advantage
* Familiarity with both manual and digital treasury processes, particularly in environments transitioning toward greater automation


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* Treasury Operations
* Cash Management
* Banking Operations
* Payment Processing
* Cheque Management
* Bank Relationship Management


 Good\-to\-Have Skills
   

  

* Financial Reconciliation
* MS Excel
* Tally / Accounting Systems
* ERP Exposure
* Manual \& Digital Treasury Processes
* Treasury Controls \& Compliance

The expense accountant will support the migration of expense accounting activities throughout EMEA and North America to the India Shared Service Center. Upon completion, the Bangalore location will be the global hub of a network of service centers that operate under generally standard processes and procedures and utilize Oracle’s ERP software solution.
   

  

 The Position Will Require Process Expertise Related To Shared Service Center Operations. The Expense Accountant Will Be Part Of a Team Of Professional Accountants Performing Accounting Services In The Areas Of
   

  

* Payroll \& incentives accounting.
* Prepayments \& corporate accruals
* Professional \& IT costs
* Advertising \& marketing costs
* Facility costs
* Goods received not invoiced accruals
* Corporate regional and BU allocations


 The position will require extensive business partnering with our business units and effective communication across functions and finance management and global operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The expense accountant will be responsible for providing accounting services including continuous improvement of processes and internal controls as well as contributing to the overall vision for Company’s shared services evolution.
   

  

* Supporting the Accounting Leader, Expense in the establishment of the expense accounting team in the India Shared Service Center including implementation of standard business processes and governance for identified processes in\-scope as documented in our finance blueprint.
* Deliver successful transition of expense accounting finance processes from the local finance teams in the United States and Ireland (and other locations as required) to the India Shared Service Center.
* Ensure performance to targeted Global Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to align with delivery of desired service level to the business.
* Integrate expense accounting finance processes of new acquisitions into the India Shared Service Center.
* Work closely with teams across the shared services organization and in the business lines to identify and implement opportunities for efficiencies (including the ERP IT team).


**Behavioral Characteristics**
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work with cross\-functional management (operations, sales, etc.) and finance management.
* Ability to build a positive rapport with personnel throughout the global organization.
* High sense of urgency and ability to identify creative solutions to advanced, time sensitive problems by balancing achievement of process objectives with practical considerations.
* Strong customer service focus, with a drive to ensure that we exceed the expectations of our customers.
* Ability to establish \& implement processes and perform in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong ability to pursue best practices in back\-office operations, commitment to delivering quality results and overcoming obstacles and challenges in a time\-sensitive environment.
* Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple responsibilities while remaining calm and effective under pressure.
* Exhibit a positive attitude and maintain poise under pressure.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting/finance with a CPA or Chartered Accountant certification or other similar qualification.
* Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience, including 2 years of experience in global shared service center environment.
* Knowledge of financial systems skills and reporting tools (experience with PeopleSoft a plus).

title: Workday Finance Functional
description:
**Position Summary**
 Deloitte USI Consulting Services is looking for Workday Finance \& Supply Chain functional professionals with proven hands\-on experience in at least one full ERP implementation project.
   

  

****Summary****
 As a Workday practitioner at Deloitte USI Consulting Services, you will design, configure, and deploy enterprise\-scale Workday solutions, collaborating with cross\-functional and global teams to translate client business requirements into effective functional designs and deliverables. You will independently manage your workstream responsibilities while guiding and mentoring junior team members, bringing structure and expertise to every stage of the engagement. Your role spans the full project lifecycle — from estimation and planning through execution and post go\-live support — ensuring high\-quality, timely delivery of solutions that meet client needs and project standards.
   

  

**Work You’ll do**
 You will play a key role in ensuring the successful implementation of Workday Finance \& Supply Chain Management project, engaging across all project stages — requirements gathering, solution design through post go\-live support. In this role, you will analyze client business requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solution designs, configuring and validating Workday Financial and SCM business processes to ensure solutions are accurately built and aligned to client needs. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional and technical teams on design, testing, and integration activities, supporting seamless and effective end\-to\-end delivery.
   

  

****Qualifications****
* 6\+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience in Workday Financials, SCM or related ERP functional roles with good understanding of accounting and business knowledge.
* Hands\-on experience in at least one end\-to\-end ERP implementation project in a functional role; multiple full lifecycle implementations are preferred and expected for more experienced resources.
* Prior to Workday if the candidate has experience in other ERP packages such as Oracle Cloud, Oracle EBS, PeopleSoft and SAP FICO with demonstrated ability to transition into newer technologies will also be considered for this opportunity.
* Functional proficiency in one or more Finance or Supply Chain Management areas, as outlined below. Proficiency across multiple functional areas is expected for more senior resources.
+ Finance — Financial Accounting, Business Assets, Banking \& Cash Management, Expense Management, Customer Accounts, Customer Contracts, Project Billing, Capital Projects, Grants and Gifts
+ Supply Chain Management — Procurement, Accounts Payable, Inventory, and Strategic Sourcing

* Strong understanding of financial accounting and its application within ERP systems, including close processes.
* Ability to gather and analyze business requirements, translate them into functional design solutions, and configure or validate system setups in line with client needs. Senior resources should be able to lead the discussions in design sessions with the client stakeholders.
* Experience in conducting and supporting system testing cycles including SIT and UAT, resolving functional defects, and ensuring solutions meet business requirements.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to team capability building; more senior resources are expected to lead functional workstreams and be accountable for overall delivery.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills with sound judgment and a structured approach to resolving functional challenges

Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Investment Decisioning -Cards Finance-Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Cards Finance Analyst within our Finance team, you will define, refine, and deliver financial goals that support our firm's card acquisition strategy. You will collaborate with cross\-functional partners in Marketing, Sales, and Product to align financial objectives with business goals and promote market expansion and customer growth. You will perform detailed financial analyses, including cost\-benefit assessments, ROI and NPV calculations, and performance tracking to inform investment decisions. You will forecast financial results for acquisition initiatives using advanced analytical techniques and scenario\-based modeling to guide resource allocation. You will build comprehensive financial business cases that quantify ROI, payback periods, and sensitivities to key promoters for strategic initiatives. You will design and maintain reports and dashboards that provide timely, accurate financial results and insights to senior leadership. You will prepare and present regular financial reports, forecasts, and executive\-ready presentations that highlight key trends, risks, and opportunities. You will define and monitor KPIs and success metrics to evaluate campaign performance and promote continuous improvement. You will enhance financial controls and streamline processes by introducing automation to reduce cycle times and error rates. You will cultivate strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, providing clear, data\-promoten recommendations that support informed decision\-making.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Track and evaluate card acquisition campaign performance, leveraging data\-driven insights to optimize strategies and improve outcomes.
* Forecast financial results for acquisition strategies using advanced statistical techniques (e.g., time series modeling, cohort analysis, scenario planning, Monte Carlo simulations) to guide investment decisions.
* Define and monitor KPIs and success metrics to measure performance and drive continuous improvement.
* Build comprehensive financial business cases that support strategic initiatives and quantify ROI, payback, and sensitivity to key drivers.
* Develop and track performance metrics; create executive\-ready presentations; and deliver financial analysis on a wide range of topics for senior management.
* Partner closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product to align financial objectives with business goals and accelerate card acquisition.
* Cultivate strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, providing financial expertise and timely support.
* Design and implement new reports and dashboards to efficiently deliver financial results and insights to senior leadership.
* Enhance controls and streamline processes, introducing automation to reduce cycle times and error rates.
* Prepare insightful, high\-quality senior management presentations with clear narratives and actionable recommendations.
* Ensure all reports include insightful commentary on key movements, underlying drivers, and watch items.


 Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting packages as required.
   

  

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* CFA/ MBA/ (Finance)/ PG in Statistics/Economics(or similar educational background)
* Strong financial analytical skills – Fusion of Finance and Data Capabilities
* Excellent communication and partnering skills. Ability to multi\-task and work autonomously within team environment
* Ability to research issues/problems and provide a 'solution\-based' approach. Adaptable to change and ambiguity in the work environment
* Expert knowledge of Excel (i.e. use of pivot tables, macros, arrays, etc)
* Inquisitive, enthusiastic, and diligent, and capable of challenging status quo
* Highly motivated and able to thrive and think clearly under pressure and tight deadlines
* Highly motivated self\-starter with excellent time management/prioritization skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 3\+ years of experience in finance, preferably within the banking or financial services industry.
* Background in Data Science a strong plus. Experience in SQL/SAS/Python/Tableau a plus


**About Us**
 JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
   

  

 We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.
   

  

 Global Finance \& Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.
